findings.message: Only 8 of 30 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 4 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 202px in "Apply for an account", 120px in "Time in Heraklion", 106px in "Ελ. Βενιζέλου 129".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.
